scripts.dev:web: cross-env APRAXIA_CLOUD_DEV=1 VITE_APRAXIA_RUNTIME=cloud npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev:legacy-web: cross-env APRAXIA_CLOUD_DEV=0 VITE_APRAXIA_RUNTIME=legacy npm run dev --workspace=frontend
